page_annotations: The images were reviewed: the overview and all six native tiles, covering the top, middle, bottom, gutter and outer margins.
Apart from the folio number, the ruled page has no catalogue entries, headings or legible annotations.

Faint mirror-image show-through of the recto (fol. 187) is visible across the page. This includes a reversed capitalised 'MAHĀBHĀRATA' heading near mid-page and entry lines in the lower half. It is not writing on this page and is not transcribed.

Non-text marks have no legible text. They include: a grey smudge or rubbing trailing diagonally near the top centre (approx. [1770,610,540,530]); small specks and ticks at the gutter edge (approx. y 550, 2300, 2985); a dark spot near [865,2860]; a cluster of specks near [1225,3750]; a vertical row of specks near [2365,4255]; and a short diagonal scratch near the bottom edge [2400,4785].
A white binding thread lies beyond the right page edge and is not a mark on the page.
Extremely faint pencil writing hidden beneath the show-through cannot be completely excluded, but none was identified.

coverage.finding: The folio number in the top-left corner reads '187' followed by a raised looped 'b'-like character, at native approx. [370,305,140,140]. Record r001 transcribes it as '187ᵇ'. That reading is consistent with the image and with the supplied label 'fol. 187b'. The candidate keeps the uncertainty about the final character, which is appropriate.

unresolved.issue: Edge terminology is inconsistent. The binding thread runs beyond the RIGHT edge, and the left edge shows the stacked edges of several leaves. The left edge is therefore probably the outer edge, not the gutter. The inventory and page_annotations call the left-edge specks (approx. y 560, 2300, 2990) 'gutter' marks. The speck near y 550 is actually at about x 565, not at the edge; there is a separate small tick at the left edge at about [330,540,25,40]. This affects only the description of non-text marks.
unresolved.next_check: Confirm the binding side against the volume structure before relying on 'gutter' and 'outer margin' labels.

unresolved.issue: Some non-text marks are not inventoried. These are a small diagonal crease or mark at the top-right corner (approx. [3100,300,50,50]) and a broad faint grey shadow or rubbing in the upper right (approx. [2380,430,300,320]). Neither contains legible text.
unresolved.next_check: Optional: add these to the list of non-text marks. No record is needed.

unresolved.issue: The page annotation renders the reversed show-through heading as 'MAHĀBHĀRATA' with macrons. On this page the reversed letters are visible but the macrons are not securely discernible; the macronised form comes from the recto. This is show-through and is not transcribed.
unresolved.next_check: If the annotation is kept, describe it as show-through of the recto heading rather than as a reading of this page.
